profile.name: Dr. Siraj Ahmad
profile.shortBio: Dr. Siraj Ahmad is a medical educator, pharmacology specialist, author and physician whose work brings together clinical medicine and medical education.
fullBio: Dr. Siraj Ahmad is a medical educator, pharmacology specialist, author and physician with a professional background spanning clinical medicine and medical education.
He holds an MD in Pharmacology from Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Aligarh Muslim University, and is associated with PW MedEd as a Pharmacology Faculty member.
His clinical background includes roles at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, AIIMS New Delhi and Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College.
His teaching connects drug mechanisms with clinical relevance, using concept-based explanations, question practice and focused revision for MBBS, NEET-PG, FMGE and INI-CET learners.
His educational resources include FMGE Solutions and PharmaNext. Through classroom teaching and online lectures, he helps students make complex medical subjects more approachable.
profile.mission: Build strong concepts, connect pharmacology with clinical practice, and revise with purpose.
profile.vision: Help aspiring doctors learn with understanding and confidence.
